    Descent of distributive Hom structure along full quotient functors #

    A full additive linear functor which is surjective on objects transports the two local properties packaged by HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure: pull back Hom subbimodules to compare them, and lift a morphism and its endpoint endomorphisms to transport transit or cotransit.

    HasBGRSDistributiveHomStructure k D

    Distributive Hom structure descends along a full additive linear functor whose object map is surjective.
